title: Nice quality made.
text: Nice quality made.. This gnome comes on a box that makes it ready for gift giving. Im keeping mine tho because he is so cute!! Without the height of the tall hat, he sits about 10 inches..then he has the skinny long hat so this makes him a nice size to sit on a shelf or mantle. There is a sand base inside to give it a sturdy weight. The material on the whole gnome is very soft..including the hat. The hat also has a wire inside that makes it posable... Very cute guy!

product_metadata.title: 48 Inch Christmas Tree Skirt Baby Blue Sequin Tree Skirt Round Sparkle Fabric Xmas Tree Skirt Mat for Holiday Decorations
features: 🎄Christmas Tree Skirt-1pc 48inch round sequin Christmas tree skirt with a waterproof packaging bag. Designed for 4~6ft trees. (depending on fullness)
🎄Sequin Tree Skirt－Covered with one piece shiny High density round sequins.Sequin front and cotton backing,thick & durable.And the spakle tree skirt reflects beautifully when light on.
🎄Widely Use-Sequin tree skirts make wonderful decorations for your Christmas tree at home, weddings, bridal, baby showers, birthdays, classic candy buffets, supermarkets and more.
🎄Easy to install-3 velcro at the opening to secure tree skirt around, so the handmade Xmas tree skirt will not move easily. With velcro design,makes the sequin Christmas Tree skirt easy to install.

🎄Care Instuction -It is recommended to wash the sequined tree skirt by hand in cold water and hang to dry.It is normal for some sequins to fall off. Please shake the Christmas tree skirt a little before use.
